- [family/iterative] `iterative`: explored in 2 spec(s) (344 evaluations), on the front in 1; on the front in low_area_control (code; runs 20261009-173845-039a, 20261009-174055-b15d)
- [family/pipelined] `pipelined`: explored in 2 spec(s) (63 evaluations), on the front in 0; never reached a front on this device so far (code; runs 20261009-173845-039a, 20261009-174055-b15d)
- [family/pipelined_m] `pipelined_m`: explored in 2 spec(s) (340 evaluations), on the front in 1; on the front in bursty_offload (code; runs 20261009-173845-039a, 20261009-174055-b15d)
- [family/unrolled_k] `unrolled_k`: explored in 2 spec(s) (53 evaluations), on the front in 0; never reached a front on this device so far (code; runs 20261009-173845-039a, 20261009-174055-b15d)
- [spec_class/low-rate (< 10 MSPS), no system scenario] spec class 'low-rate (< 10 MSPS), no system scenario': 1 front-mapping round(s) in 1 spec run(s), mean HV gain +443.7% (min +443.7%, max +443.7%) (code; runs 20261009-173845-039a)
- [spec_class/low-rate (< 10 MSPS), system: bursty] spec class 'low-rate (< 10 MSPS), system: bursty': 3 front-mapping round(s) in 1 spec run(s), mean HV gain +23.5% (min +0.3%, max +55.0%) (code; runs 20261009-174055-b15d)
- [note/low_area_control] For area-min CORDIC specs, iterative family with data_width=16, n_iter=12, truncation wins (267 LUTs+FFs, 10.5 acc bits, 13.2 MSPS). L3/L4 have no recorded rows for this design class, so back_annotate returns no_measured_data and reexplore is refused; finalize directly after L2. (LLM note; runs 20261009-173845-039a)
- [note/note/bursty_offload] For bursty specs (bursts of 8, Poisson 2 req/us, p99 <= 0.4 us), pipelined_m wins: dw=15, n_iter=14, m=7 (855 LUTs+FFs est, 10.6 acc bits, 59.6 MSPS, simulated p99 0.233 us). L1 analytic p99 bound was optimistic (~0.17 vs simulated 0.233) but still passed. pipelined_m reached the front here, unlike prior campaigns. No L3/L4 measured rows; back_annotate no_measured_data, finalize directly. (LLM note; runs 20261009-174055-b15d)

Spec queue:
- dds_250msps [not started; 0/400 L1 evaluations used]
    spec dds_250msps: NCO / DDS sin-cos generator for a digital up-converter. One sample per clock at >= 250 MSPS, max error <= 2^-13. Minimise LUTs.
      constraint: throughput_msps >= 250
      constraint: max_abs_err <= 0.00012207
      objective: min luts (HV ref 4000)
      objective: max accuracy_bits (HV ref 13)
      select: min luts
      budget: 400 evals, 100/round, <= 4 rounds, eps 0.01

args.notes: High-throughput spec: needs >=250 MSPS, so iterative family (13.2 MSPS at dw=16/n_iter=12) is far too slow; unrolled_k and pipelined have never reached a front on this device. Focus budget on pipelined_m (won bursty spec at dw=15, n_iter=14, m=7, 59.6 MSPS) with larger m for throughput, and a small check of unrolled_k for area. Selection rule is min LUTs subject to throughput>=250 and accuracy>=13 bits.

result: finalized dds_250msps: `pipelined:data_width=19,n_iter=15,angle_guard=0,frac_guard=0,rounding=round`: luts=935, accuracy_bits=13.2, ffs=969, throughput_msps=264, max_abs_err=0.000108 (2^-13.18) (400 L1 evaluations).

args.lesson: For the 250 MSPS DDS spec (min LUTs, err <= 2^-13), plain pipelined family won: dw=19, n_iter=15, no guards, round (935 LUTs est, 13.2 acc bits, 264 MSPS, 2^-13.18). Notable: pipelined reached the front here, unlike prior campaigns where it never did; pipelined_m and unrolled_k did not beat it on LUTs at this throughput. L2 DDS sim: SFDR 100.5 dBc, SNR 88.3 dB. No L3/L4 measured rows; back_annotate no_measured_data, finalize directly.
